findings.passage: I believe that the election law changes will have an overall positive impact on voter participation. I do have concerns regarding the timing of many of the changes that are being implemented. To change machines and introduce mail-in ballots so close to a presidential election could add to confusion among voters and potentially allow for fraud without the right checks and balances.
findings.note: His written answer in The Morning Call candidate Q&A, asked whether he is comfortable with the state's election process. He says the 2019-20 election law changes may raise participation but worries about their timing and the need for checks. Nothing on voter ID.
